info.title: Anywhere agent API
info.description:
Read and change a person's Anywhere map: the places they saved and the ones they go to, their visits and trips (all of their history), and where they are now.

**Authentication.** Every call carries the person's personal token, made in the Anywhere app: `Authorization: Bearer anyw_pat_…`. The same token connects an MCP client to `https://anywhere.fenn.chat/mcp` (Streamable HTTP), whose tools are these operations under the same names.

**The person is told.** Every call that reads or changes their places, history or location is recorded and shown to them in the app. Every change can be undone there.

**Limits,** per token: 1000 calls a day (UTC) and 60 a minute, 200 changes to the map a day; 429 with Retry-After beyond them.

**Conventions.** Times are ISO 8601 in UTC, to the millisecond; coordinates WGS84 degrees. Lists come in pages of up to 200 items: pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` for the next, with the same filters. GET answers carry an ETag (If-None-Match gives 304 while it holds); `updated_since` lists what changed since a time. Errors are `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }`. Adding a place takes an Idempotency-Key.

get.description: The person (their name, and the time zone to show times in) and this connection: its agent, its limits and what it used today.

ETag.description: The answer's version: send it as If-None-Match to get 304 while it holds

304.description: Not modified: the If-None-Match ETag still holds

get.description: The places on the person's map: saved ones (in a list, favorite or wantToGo, or none) and ones they go to without saving them (home, work…). Latest change first, or nearest first with `near`. Each has its label, private note, origin and visit stats. Filters combine; follow `next_cursor` for more.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only these: favorite or wantToGo (the person's lists), saved (saved without a list), unconfirmed (the yellow ?: venue to confirm)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words to find in names, addresses, categories, labels and notes, ignoring case and accents

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: A box: min_lat,min_lng,max_lat,max_lng in degrees; a min_lng east of max_lng crosses the antimeridian

parameters.name: near
parameters.description: A point, lat,lng in degrees: the places within radius_m of it, nearest first

parameters.name: radius_m
parameters.description: With near: how far, in meters (1000 by default, 100000 at most)

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Only what changed since then, for incremental sync: the places found that changed, and in `removed` the ids that changed and are no longer found (taken off the map, or no longer matching the other filters). Pass the newest `updated_at` or `removed_at` your copy holds (the server's times), not your own clock's

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page, at most 200

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, with the same filters

ETag.description: The answer's version: send it as If-None-Match to get 304 while it holds

304.description: Not modified: the If-None-Match ETag still holds

post.description: Saves a venue on the person's map, in a list (favorite, wantToGo) or none, with a note. A venue already on the map (the same provider id, or the same name within 100 m) is never added twice: that place takes the stronger status and the note. The person is told, and can undo it in the app.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of your own for this request (a UUID): a retry with the same key and the same input answers the first response again, without a second change

category.description: Its category, which picks the pin's icon

provider_ids.description: The venue's ids, primary first: one already on the map makes this that place

items.description: apple:<Apple Maps id> or google:<Google place id>

status.description: favorite or wantToGo; saved without a list when left out

note.description: The person's note on the place, up to 4000 characters

200.description: Merged: the venue was on the map already

201.description: Created: a new place (Location names it)

get.description: One place of the person's map, by its id: its status, label, private note, origin and visit stats.

parameters.name: place_id
parameters.description: A place's id, from list_places

ETag.description: The answer's version: send it as If-None-Match to get 304 while it holds

304.description: Not modified: the If-None-Match ETag still holds

patch.description: Changes what is given of a place: a saved place's status, note or name; the label (home, work, school) of a place the person has been to. The person is told, and can undo a status, note or name in the app.

parameters.name: place_id
parameters.description: A place's id, from list_places

status.description: favorite, wantToGo, or null for no list

note.description: The person's note; null or blank clears it

label.description: home, work or school, or null for none of them: only a place the person has been to takes one. A place on the map for its label alone (too short a stay for a pin) leaves it without one: outcome removed

delete.summary: Take a place off the map
delete.description: Takes a saved place off the person's map. The person is told, and can undo it in the app.

personalToken.description: A personal token (anyw_pat_…) the person made in the Anywhere app

id.description: The place's id: a saved place's own, or, for a place the person goes to without having saved it, the location engine's

kind.description: saved: on the map because it was saved (by the person, an agent, a chat or an import). visited: on the map because the person goes there (a home, a workplace, a café they stayed at) without having saved it

name.description: What the place is called; null for a visited place nothing named yet

category.description: Its category: restaurant, cafe, park, museum, hotel…

provider_ids.description: The venue's ids at Apple Maps (apple:<id>) and Google (google:<place id>)

status.description: The person's list: favorite, wantToGo, or null for saved without a list (always null for a visited place)

unconfirmed.description: Shown with a yellow ? on the map: which venue it is waits for the person's confirmation

label.description: The person's home, work or school: the label they gave it, or the one their stays there earned

note.description: The person's private note on it; saved places only

kind.description: me: the person, in the app. agent: an agent, named (Fenn, the app's own, or an outside one like you). chat: a place a chat message named. screenshot: a screenshot shared in the app. import: brought from Google Maps. visit: a place the person went to.

name.description: The agent's name, for kind agent

origin.description: Who put the place on the map; it never changes

visit_count.description: Times the person has been there, over all their history

last_visit.description: When the last visit ended (began, while it goes on)

distance_m.description: Meters from `near`, in a search near a point

created_at.description: When it was saved; null for a visited place

updated_at.description: When anything about it last changed, its visits included: the time `updated_since` compares

Place.description: A place on the person's map: one they saved, or one they go to

removed_at.description: Its latest change: when it left the map, or the search

RemovedPlace.description: With `updated_since`: an id that changed since then and is not among the places found, taken off the map or no longer matching the search. Delete it from your copy; you may never have had it

id.description: The place on the map it is (GET /places/{id}); null when no pin stands for it: a short stop, a place the person hid

PlaceRef.description: A place, as a visit or a trip names it

place.description: Where; null when that place is gone

departure.description: null while the person is still there

duration_s.description: Seconds there; null while it goes on

origin.description: Where it began; null when unknown

destination.description: Where it ended; null when unknown

mode.description: How the person mostly moved: walking, running, cycling, automotive…; null when unsure

stops.description: Stops too short to end the trip

outcome.description: created: a new place. merged: the venue was on the map already; that place took the stronger status (favorite over wantToGo over none). updated, unchanged: what an edit did. removed: off the map

place.description: The place now; as it was, once removed

change_id.description: The change the person can undo in the app; null when nothing undoable changed

WriteResult.description: What a change to the map did

code.description: Stable, snake_case: invalid_token, invalid_request, place_not_found, quota_exceeded…

BadRequest.description: The request does not match this document: the message says how (invalid_request, invalid_cursor, invalid_json)

Unauthorized.description: No valid token: missing, malformed, unknown or revoked (invalid_token)

NotFound.description: No such place on the map (place_not_found), path (not_found) or location (location_not_shared)

Conflict.description: The change cannot be made: a visited place takes only a label (not_saved), a label needs visits (not_visited), an Idempotency-Key reused for another request (idempotency_conflict)

TooManyRequests.description: A limit is reached (quota_exceeded) or this address presented too many unknown tokens today (too_many_attempts); Retry-After says when to retry, when waiting helps

Unavailable.description: Switched off for now, or a dependency is down (agents_api_disabled, quota_unavailable, lookup_failed, activity_unavailable, idempotency_unavailable): retry later
